decisions.reason: The electronic music box adds a technology element to the firm's existing music-feature and church-motif design knowledge, so it is less embedded in core skills and riskier, but it fits the stated direction of blending tradition with technology and the firm can learn from early sales.
A wooden nativity stable builds directly on the firm's long-held handcraft and seasonal design knowledge, so the firm can readily interpret results and refine it within its in-house workshops.

A modern incense smoker builds on a traditional Erzgebirge-style product the firm knows well, combining it with contemporary design, which absorptive capacity suggests the firm can assimilate and improve.
